summary.name: ModelRush
summary.one_liner: ModelRush is a single API for calling text, image, video, and voice AI models through one OpenAI-compatible endpoint, with per-model pricing and request tracing.
keywords: one api key for ai models
use_cases: call text, image, video and voice models from one codebase
submit text-to-video generation jobs and poll for results
compare model prices and regional availability before choosing a model
trace request latency, tokens and errors for debugging
switch AI models without rewriting integration code
summary.what_it_does: The page describes ModelRush as a unified model infrastructure layer exposing text, image, video, and audio models behind one OpenAI-compatible API at api.modelrush.ai/v1. Video generation is asynchronous: a POST returns HTTP 202 with a job id and poll_url, which are then polled until completion or failure. The example model shown is Seedance 2.5 Spicy text-to-video, listed at $0.127 per second at 480P. Each request gets a unique ID and records model, status, tokens, latency, and errors in a dashboard. The page also offers a copyable agent prompt and a manual TypeScript/Python integration example using a Bearer API key read from the environment.
notable: One OpenAI-compatible endpoint covering text, image, video, and speech models
Per-request tracing with request_id, status, latency, and errors
Public per-model pricing and regional routing
Copyable implementation brief for engineering agents
caveats: Usage is charged from prepaid credits, with top-ups of $10, $50, or $100 mentioned
Video generation jobs are asynchronous and return queued status first; paid verification requires authorization
Provider differences and data practices vary by model layer, per the page
